events.name: San Francisco Giants at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers hit his 30th home run of the season and rookie Turner Hill had a two-run double as the San Francisco Giants snapped the Atlanta Braves' seven-game winning streak with a 7-3 win Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devers hits his 30th homer as the Giants snap the Braves’ 7-game streak

events.name: New York Mets at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Robert Stock pitched shutout ball into the sixth inning for his first major league win in seven years, Mark Vientos homered in his return from the injured list and the New York Mets beat the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robert Stock's first major league win in 7 years lifts Mets past Rays, 3-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Manny Machado had four hits, Michael King struck out six in six innings and the San Diego Padres defeated the Cincinnati Reds 5-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado has 4-hit game, King fans 6 in 6 innings as the Padres beat the Reds 5-0

headlines.description: — Daylen Lile homered twice and drove in four runs, Erik Tolman pitched out of a bases-loaded jam to earn his first major league save, and the Washington Nationals beat the Miami Marlins 6-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daylen Lile continues hot streak with 2 homers as Nationals beat Marlins 6-3

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Trevor Story drove in the winning run with a bases-loaded single in the 10th inning after Seattle walked the two batters before him intentionally, lifting the Boston Red Sox to a 9-8 comeback victory over the Mariners on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Story hits a bases-loaded RBI single in 10th to lift Red Sox to 9-8 win over Mariners

headlines.description: — Ryan Jeffers had two homers, Walker Jenkins went deep for the first time in his major league career, and the Minnesota Twins beat the Detroit Tigers 11-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Jeffers hits 2 HRs, Walker Jenkins has 1st MLB HR as Twins defeat Tigers 11-1

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman hit three of Chicago's franchise-record nine home runs and the Cubs punctuated their August power display with a 17-3 blowout of the Milwaukee Brewers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Bregman hits 3 home runs and Cubs set team record with 9 in 17-3 rout of Brewers

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom allowed a second-inning single in seven shutout innings while bouncing back from one of his worst major league starts, and the Texas Rangers beat the Athletics 8-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeGrom strikes out 8, allows 1 hit in 7 shutout innings as the Rangers beat the A's 8-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Nelson Velázquez hit a two-run homer and Cam Smith added a two-run double to lead the Houston Astros to a 6-3 win over the Chicago White Sox on Monday night in a series opener between American League division leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Velázquez hits 2-run homer and Smith adds 2-run double as Astros surge past White Sox, 6-3

headlines.shortLinkText: Colton Cowser saves Orioles with incredible catch to preserve 2-1 victory over Rockies

events.name: New York Yankees at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Vaughn Grissom drove in four runs, rookie Walbert Ureña pitched seven strong innings and the Los Angeles Angels ended a seven-game losing streak with a 10-1 victory over the sloppy New York Yankees on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angels end 7-game slide with 10-1 win over sloppy Yankees behind Grissom and Ureña

headlines.description: — Bryson Stott hit a homer, Aaron Nola provided another solid start on the mound and the Philadelphia Phillies finished a torrid August with a 2-1 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryson Stott hits a solo HR, Phillies beat the Diamondbacks 2-1 to cap 21-win August
